Retains the pool's instance classification contract.

@staticmethod
def classify_result( agent_id: str, result: howlplane.control_plane.agent_execution.AgentExecutionResult) -> howlplane.control_plane.resource_models.ProviderFailureClass: 
798    @staticmethod
799    def classify_result(
800        agent_id: str,
801        result: AgentExecutionResult,
802    ) -> ProviderFailureClass:
803        """Normalizes availability separately from engineering results."""
804        if result.success:
805            return ProviderFailureClass.UNKNOWN
806        resource_id = AgentBackendRegistry.normalize_agent_id(agent_id)
807        combined = "\n".join(
808            [result.error_message or "", result.stderr or "", result.stdout or ""]
809        ).lower()
810        # Structural execution evidence outranks transcript text. A long agent
811        # transcript is arbitrary third-party content that routinely contains the
812        # very phrases these markers look for, so where the harness observed the
813        # process directly, that observation wins (SLOPFIX-03).
814        metadata = result.metadata or {}
815        if metadata.get(WATCHDOG_TERMINATION_KEY) == WATCHDOG_TERMINATION_STALL:
816            return ProviderFailureClass.PROVIDER_STALLED
817        launch_outcome = metadata.get(LAUNCH_OUTCOME_KEY)
818        if launch_outcome in (LAUNCH_OUTCOME_NOT_INSTALLED, LAUNCH_OUTCOME_SPAWN_FAILED):
819            return ProviderFailureClass.MISSING_EXECUTABLE
820        # A harness-sourced or budget-derived timeout is this process stopping
821        # the provider at our own budget (either directly via harness kill or
822        # via a harness-derived print timeout). Nothing was observed about
823        # reachability, so it is an execution budget result, not a transport
824        # failure. Transcript-sourced timeouts without budget derivation still
825        # fall through to the transport branch below, where a provider genuinely
826        # reporting that it could not reach its service is classified as
827        # TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE and benched (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-05).
828        # A vendor trust refusal opens the output before any work happens. It
829        # outranks a deadline only when positively identified for this CLI: a
830        # session that sat on its own trust prompt until our budget expired was
831        # blocked by the folder, not slow (see workspace_trust).
832        if result_is_trust_refusal(resource_id, result):
833            return ProviderFailureClass.WORKSPACE_TRUST_REQUIRED
834        if (
835            metadata.get(TIMEOUT_SOURCE_KEY) in (TIMEOUT_SOURCE_HARNESS, TIMEOUT_SOURCE_BUDGET)
836            or metadata.get(BUDGET_DERIVED_KEY) is True
837        ):
838            return ProviderFailureClass.EXECUTION_BUDGET_EXCEEDED
839        if launch_outcome != LAUNCH_OUTCOME_LAUNCHED and result.exit_code == 127:
840            return ProviderFailureClass.MISSING_EXECUTABLE
841
842        # A provider's exact terminal error is stronger than evidence collected
843        # earlier in its session. In particular, a hard capacity stop must not
844        # be hidden by an earlier denied tool. However, arbitrary trailing prose
845        # in stdout must NEVER override a structured denial: only authenticated
846        # structured metadata or explicit non-zero exit stderr can outrank it.
847        if metadata.get(TOOL_PERMISSION_KEY) == TOOL_PERMISSION_DENIED:
848            structured_terminal = _classify_structured_terminal_hard_failure(result)
849            if structured_terminal is not None:
850                return structured_terminal
851            return ProviderFailureClass.EXECUTION_PERMISSION_REQUIRED
852
853        # A machine-readable error envelope is the strongest signal a provider
854        # can give about why it stopped, and it does not depend on where the
855        # message happens to sit in the output. Devin's quota error is a
856        # multi-line JSON blob whose last non-empty line is "}", so the
857        # anchored line matching below cannot see it at all, whatever patterns
858        # are added (issues.md #15).
859        envelope_failure = _classify_structured_error_envelope(result)
860        if envelope_failure is not None:
861            return envelope_failure
862
863        terminal_hard_failure = _classify_terminal_hard_failure(result)
864        if terminal_hard_failure is not None:
865            return terminal_hard_failure
866
867        # A provider that demonstrably started cannot be a missing executable,
868        # whatever its session log says about commands that were not found.
869        # Backends that stamp no markers keep the older text-based behavior, with
870        # one correction: a timeout verdict is the more specific signal and so
871        # outranks the substring scan. Exit 127 remains a legacy launch verdict
872        # only when no structural launched marker contradicts it.
873        if launch_outcome != LAUNCH_OUTCOME_LAUNCHED and (
874            not result.timed_out and any(marker in combined for marker in (
875                "command not found", "binary not found", "not installed",
876            ))
877        ):
878            return ProviderFailureClass.MISSING_EXECUTABLE
879        if any(marker in combined for marker in (
880            "requires approval", "require approval", "permission denied",
881            "requires permission", "execution permission required", "execution_permission_required",
882            "needs approval", "approve bash execution",
883            # Trust prose that is not a positively identified refusal (above)
884            # keeps its conservative, pre-existing permission classification.
885            "workspace trust required", "trust the current workspace", "pass --trust",
886            "untrusted workspace",
887        )):
888            return ProviderFailureClass.EXECUTION_PERMISSION_REQUIRED
889        if any(marker in combined for marker in (
890            "authentication required", "not authenticated", "login required",
891            "unauthorized", "invalid api key",
892        )):
893            return ProviderFailureClass.AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED
894        if any(marker in combined for marker in (
895            "429 too many requests", "rate_limit", "rate limit", "rate limited",
896        )):
897            return ProviderFailureClass.RATE_LIMITED
898        if any(marker in combined for marker in (
899            "quota exhausted", "quota exceeded", "insufficient_quota",
900            "credits exhausted", "insufficient funds", "resource exhausted",
901        )):
902            return ProviderFailureClass.QUOTA_EXHAUSTED
903        session_patterns = EXHAUSTION_PATTERNS.get(resource_id, []) + [
904            "usage limit",
905            "session limit",
906            "individual quota reached",
907            "quota reached",
908            "upgrade your subscription",
909            "out of capacity",
910        ]
911        if any(marker in combined for marker in session_patterns):
912            return ProviderFailureClass.SESSION_LIMIT
913        if any(marker in combined for marker in (
914            "malformed", "invalid json", "invalid yaml", "parse error",
915        )):
916            return ProviderFailureClass.MALFORMED_OUTPUT
917        if result.timed_out or any(marker in combined for marker in (
918            "connection refused", "transport unavailable", "network unreachable",
919            "timed out", "timeout waiting for response", "request timed out",
920            "connection timed out", "gateway timeout", "read timeout",
921            "operation timed out", "deadline exceeded", "timeout after",
922        )):
923            return ProviderFailureClass.TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE
924        if any(marker in combined for marker in (
925            "provider unavailable", "service unavailable", "overloaded_error", "outage",
926        )):
927            return ProviderFailureClass.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE
928        return ProviderFailureClass.ENGINEERING_FAILURE

Normalizes availability separately from engineering results.

def record_result( self, agent_id: str, result: howlplane.control_plane.agent_execution.AgentExecutionResult, task_id: Optional[str] = None, role: Optional[str] = None) -> howlplane.control_plane.resource_models.ProviderFailureClass: 
 930    def record_result(
 931        self,
 932        agent_id: str,
 933        result: AgentExecutionResult,
 934        task_id: Optional[str] = None,
 935        role: Optional[str] = None,
 936    ) -> ProviderFailureClass:
 937        """Updates shared state only when the observed result warrants it."""
 938        resource_id = self._normalize(agent_id)
 939        state = self._provider_states.get(resource_id)
 940        if state is None:
 941            raise KeyError(f"Unknown resource '{resource_id}'.")
 942        now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
 943        profile = self.registry.get_resource(resource_id)
 944        if (
 945            profile is not None
 946            and profile.economic_class == EconomicClass.METERED_API.value
 947        ):
 948            state.metered_invocation_count += 1
 949            self._persist()
 950        if result.success:
 951            state.status = ProviderAvailabilityStatus.AVAILABLE
 952            state.normalized_failure_class = None
 953            state.unavailable_reason = None
 954            state.exhaustion_event = None
 955            state.success_count += 1
 956            state.total_duration_seconds += result.duration_seconds
 957            state.last_success_at = now.isoformat()
 958            state.last_checked = now.isoformat()
 959            state.observed_at = now.isoformat()
 960            state.retry_after = None
 961            if role and role in state.role_exclusions:
 962                state.role_exclusions.pop(role, None)
 963            self._persist()
 964            return ProviderFailureClass.UNKNOWN
 965
 966        failure_class = self.classify_failure(resource_id, result)
 967        metadata = result.metadata or {}
 968        if failure_class is ProviderFailureClass.WORKSPACE_TRUST_REQUIRED:
 969            # One untrusted folder says nothing about the resource anywhere
 970            # else: availability, cooldowns, and role eligibility are unchanged.
 971            state.last_checked = now.isoformat()
 972            state.observed_at = now.isoformat()
 973            self._persist()
 974            return failure_class
 975
 976        state.consecutive_failures += 1
 977        state.last_failure_at = now.isoformat()
 978        state.last_checked = now.isoformat()
 979        state.observed_at = now.isoformat()
 980        state.normalized_failure_class = failure_class.value
 981        state.unavailable_reason = failure_class.value
 982
 983        if failure_class is ProviderFailureClass.EXECUTION_PERMISSION_REQUIRED:
 984            target_role = role or "unknown"
 985            state.role_exclusions[target_role] = failure_class.value
 986            if self._is_review_role(target_role):
 987                state.role_exclusions["review"] = failure_class.value
 988            self._persist()
 989            return failure_class
 990
 991        # EXECUTION_BUDGET_EXCEEDED previously stayed out of this map to avoid
 992        # penalizing a healthy resource for our own harness deadline. The live
 993        # incident showed repeatedly burning ~10-minute slots on the same provider
 994        # while another was available, so a bounded DEGRADED cooldown is recorded
 995        # instead. DEGRADED still leaves the provider eligible, just deprioritized,
 996        # and expires after the normal transient cooldown.
 997        availability_map = {
 998            ProviderFailureClass.EXECUTION_BUDGET_EXCEEDED: ProviderAvailabilityStatus.DEGRADED,
 999            ProviderFailureClass.QUOTA_EXHAUSTED: ProviderAvailabilityStatus.QUOTA_EXHAUSTED,
1000            ProviderFailureClass.SESSION_LIMIT: ProviderAvailabilityStatus.SESSION_EXHAUSTED,
1001            ProviderFailureClass.RATE_LIMITED: ProviderAvailabilityStatus.RATE_LIMITED,
1002            ProviderFailureClass.AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED: ProviderAvailabilityStatus.AUTH_REQUIRED,
1003            ProviderFailureClass.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: ProviderAvailabilityStatus.UNAVAILABLE,
1004            ProviderFailureClass.TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE: ProviderAvailabilityStatus.UNREACHABLE,
1005            ProviderFailureClass.MISSING_EXECUTABLE: ProviderAvailabilityStatus.MISSING_EXECUTABLE,
1006            ProviderFailureClass.PROVIDER_STALLED: ProviderAvailabilityStatus.UNAVAILABLE,
1007        }
1008        if failure_class in availability_map:
1009            state.status = availability_map[failure_class]
1010            # Every capacity condition expires. QUOTA_EXHAUSTED was absent from
1011            # this set, so a quota event had no `retry_after` at all and the
1012            # resource stayed unavailable until someone called reset_resource --
1013            # a single historical quota event permanently removing a provider
1014            # from the pool. It now expires on its own, longer clock: a quota is
1015            # billed over a day or a week, so re-probing it on the transient
1016            # cooldown would spend attempts proving what is already known
1017            # (issues.md #15).
1018            transient = {
1019                ProviderFailureClass.RATE_LIMITED,
1020                ProviderFailureClass.TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE,
1021                ProviderFailureClass.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE,
1022                ProviderFailureClass.EXECUTION_BUDGET_EXCEEDED,
1023            }
1024            cooldown = None
1025            if failure_class is ProviderFailureClass.SESSION_LIMIT:
1026                cooldown = getattr(
1027                    self.policy, "session_cooldown_seconds", None
1028                ) or 14400
1029            elif failure_class in transient:
1030                cooldown = self.policy.cooldown_seconds
1031            elif failure_class is ProviderFailureClass.QUOTA_EXHAUSTED:
1032                cooldown = getattr(
1033                    self.policy, "quota_cooldown_seconds", None
1034                ) or self.policy.cooldown_seconds
1035            explicit_retry_seconds = metadata.get(PROVIDER_RETRY_AFTER_SECONDS_KEY)
1036            if isinstance(explicit_retry_seconds, int) and explicit_retry_seconds >= 0:
1037                state.retry_after = (now + timedelta(seconds=explicit_retry_seconds)).isoformat()
1038            elif cooldown:
1039                state.retry_after = (now + timedelta(seconds=cooldown)).isoformat()
1040            state.exhaustion_event = ProviderExhaustionEvent(
1041                agent_id=resource_id,
1042                failure_type={
1043                    ProviderFailureClass.SESSION_LIMIT: "session_limit",
1044                    ProviderFailureClass.RATE_LIMITED: "rate_limit",
1045                    ProviderFailureClass.QUOTA_EXHAUSTED: "quota_exhausted",
1046                    ProviderFailureClass.AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED: "authentication_required",
1047                    ProviderFailureClass.PROVIDER_STALLED: "stalled",
1048                }.get(failure_class, "unavailable"),
1049                raw_error=(result.stderr or result.error_message or failure_class.value).strip(),
1050                task_id=task_id,
1051            )
1052            self._persist()
1053        return failure_class

Updates shared state only when the observed result warrants it.

def detect_exhaustion( self, agent_id: str, result: howlplane.control_plane.agent_execution.AgentExecutionResult, task_id: Optional[str] = None, role: Optional[str] = None) -> Optional[howlplane.control_plane.synthesis.provider_pool.ProviderExhaustionEvent]: 
1055    def detect_exhaustion(
1056        self,
1057        agent_id: str,
1058        result: AgentExecutionResult,
1059        task_id: Optional[str] = None,
1060        role: Optional[str] = None,
1061    ) -> Optional[ProviderExhaustionEvent]:
1062        """Compatibility wrapper returning events only for availability failures."""
1063        resource_id = self._normalize(agent_id)
1064        if resource_id in LOCAL_PROVIDER_IDS:
1065            reason = (result.error_message or "").upper()
1066            if reason == "RESOURCE_CONSTRAINED":
1067                event = ProviderExhaustionEvent(
1068                    agent_id=resource_id,
1069                    failure_type="unavailable",
1070                    raw_error=result.stderr or reason,
1071                    task_id=task_id,
1072                )
1073                self.set_status(
1074                    resource_id,
1075                    ProviderAvailabilityStatus.RESOURCE_CONSTRAINED,
1076                    event,
1077                )
1078                return event
1079        failure_class = self.record_result(agent_id, result, task_id=task_id, role=role)
1080        availability_classes = {
1081            ProviderFailureClass.QUOTA_EXHAUSTED,
1082            ProviderFailureClass.SESSION_LIMIT,
1083            ProviderFailureClass.RATE_LIMITED,
1084            ProviderFailureClass.AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED,
1085            ProviderFailureClass.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE,
1086            ProviderFailureClass.TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE,
1087            ProviderFailureClass.MISSING_EXECUTABLE,
1088        }
1089        if failure_class not in availability_classes:
1090            return None
1091        return self._provider_states[self._normalize(agent_id)].exhaustion_event

def reset_resource( self, resource_id: str, *, reprobe: bool = True) -> howlplane.control_plane.synthesis.provider_pool.ProviderStatus: 
1093    def reset_resource(self, resource_id: str, *, reprobe: bool = True) -> ProviderStatus:
1094        """Clears only current availability state for one configured resource."""
1095        normalized = self._normalize(resource_id)
1096        profile = self.registry.get_resource(normalized)
1097        config = self.resources.get(normalized)
1098        if profile is None or config is None:
1099            raise ProviderConfigurationError(f"Resource '{resource_id}' is not configured.")
1100        if not config.enabled:
1101            raise ProviderConfigurationError(f"Resource '{resource_id}' is operator disabled.")
1102        state = self._provider_states[normalized]
1103        state.status = ProviderAvailabilityStatus.UNKNOWN
1104        state.normalized_failure_class = None
1105        state.exhaustion_event = None
1106        state.retry_after = None
1107        state.reset_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
1108        state.unavailable_reason = None
1109        state.role_exclusions.clear()
1110        if reprobe and not self._egress_forbidden(profile):
1111            self._apply_readiness(normalized, profile, state)
1112        self._persist()
1113        return state

Clears only current availability state for one configured resource.

def reset_transient_exhaustion(self) -> None: 
1115    def reset_transient_exhaustion(self) -> None:
1116        """Compatibility reset using bounded non-generative readiness probes."""
1117        for resource_id, resource_config in self.resources.items():
1118            if resource_config.enabled:
1119                profile = self.registry.get_resource(resource_id)
1120                if profile and not self._egress_forbidden(profile):
1121                    self.reset_resource(resource_id, reprobe=True)

def check_capacity_exclusion(self, resource_id: str, role: Optional[str] = None) -> Optional[str]: 
1173    def check_capacity_exclusion(
1174        self,
1175        resource_id: str,
1176        role: Optional[str] = None,
1177    ) -> Optional[str]:
1178        """Returns the capacity block or role exclusion reason for a resource, if any."""
1179        normalized = self._normalize(resource_id)
1180        state = self._provider_states.get(normalized)
1181        if state is None:
1182            return "UNKNOWN_RESOURCE"
1183        general = self._capacity_exclusion(state.status)
1184        if general:
1185            return general
1186        if role:

1188                return f"ROLE_EXCLUDED:{state.role_exclusions[role]}"
1189            if self._is_review_role(role) and "review" in state.role_exclusions:
1190                return f"ROLE_EXCLUDED:{state.role_exclusions['review']}"
1191        return None

def select_resource( self, task: howlplane.control_plane.task_spec.TaskSpec, *, role: str, explicit_resource_id: Optional[str] = None, avoid_resource_id: Optional[str] = None, exclude_resource_ids: Optional[Iterable[str]] = None) -> howlplane.control_plane.resource_models.ResourceSelectionDecision: 
1271    def select_resource(
1272        self,
1273        task: TaskSpec,
1274        *,
1275        role: str,
1276        explicit_resource_id: Optional[str] = None,
1277        avoid_resource_id: Optional[str] = None,
1278        exclude_resource_ids: Optional[Iterable[str]] = None,
1279    ) -> ResourceSelectionDecision:
1280        """Applies hard filtering, economics, recommendation, and stable tie break.
1281
1282        ``avoid_resource_id`` is a soft preference that only demotes a resource in
1283        the ranking. ``exclude_resource_ids`` is a hard prohibition, used by
1284        bounded failover so a resource whose cooldown elapsed mid-attempt cannot
1285        be re-offered and dead-end the loop.
1286        """
1287        required = self._required_capabilities(task, role)
1288        excluded_ids = {
1289            self._normalize(item) for item in (exclude_resource_ids or []) if item
1290        }
1291        registered = [
1292            self._resource_identity(profile) for profile in self.registry.list_resources()
1293        ]
1294        exclusions: List[ResourceExclusion] = []
1295        candidates: List[AgentProfile] = []
1296        task_forbids_egress = self._task_forbids_egress(task)
1297
1298        def exclude(profile: AgentProfile, reason: str, stage: str, detail=None):
1299            exclusions.append(ResourceExclusion(
1300                resource_id=profile.resource_id or profile.agent_id,
1301                reason=reason,
1302                stage=stage,
1303                detail=detail,
1304            ))
1305
1306        for profile in self.registry.list_resources():
1307            resource_id = profile.resource_id or profile.agent_id
1308            resource_config = self.resources.get(resource_id)
1309            state = self._provider_states[resource_id]
1310            if resource_config is None:
1311                exclude(profile, "NOT_CONFIGURED", "operator_permission")
1312                continue
1313            if not resource_config.enabled:
1314                exclude(profile, "OPERATOR_DISABLED", "operator_permission")
1315                continue
1316            if self._egress_forbidden(profile):
1317                exclude(profile, "EGRESS_FORBIDDEN", "egress_policy")
1318                continue
1319            if task_forbids_egress and profile.locality != ResourceLocality.LOCAL.value:
1320                exclude(profile, "TASK_EGRESS_FORBIDDEN", "egress_policy")
1321                continue
1322            self._recover_capacity_if_due(resource_id, profile, state)
1323            if state.readiness in {
1324                ReadinessStatus.MISSING_EXECUTABLE,
1325                ReadinessStatus.AUTH_REQUIRED,
1326                ReadinessStatus.UNREACHABLE,
1327                ReadinessStatus.UNAVAILABLE,
1328            }:
1329                exclude(profile, state.readiness.value, "runtime_readiness")
1330                continue
1331            if role not in profile.roles and not (
1332                self._is_review_role(role) and "review" in profile.roles
1333            ):
1334                exclude(profile, "ROLE_NOT_SUPPORTED", "capability")
1335                continue
1336            missing = [cap for cap in required if not self._has_capability(profile, cap)]
1337            if missing:
1338                exclude(
1339                    profile,
1340                    "MISSING_REQUIRED_CAPABILITY",
1341                    "capability",
1342                    ",".join(missing),
1343                )
1344                continue
1345            if role in LOCAL_INELIGIBLE_REVIEWER_ROLES and profile.locality == ResourceLocality.LOCAL.value:
1346                exclude(profile, "LOCAL_REVIEW_AUTHORITY_FORBIDDEN", "authority")
1347                continue
1348            capacity_reason = self._capacity_exclusion(state.status)
1349            if capacity_reason:
1350                exclude(profile, capacity_reason, "capacity")
1351                continue
1352            if role in state.role_exclusions:
1353                exclude(profile, f"ROLE_EXCLUDED:{state.role_exclusions[role]}", "capacity")
1354                continue
1355            if self._is_review_role(role) and "review" in state.role_exclusions:
1356                exclude(profile, f"ROLE_EXCLUDED:{state.role_exclusions['review']}", "capacity")
1357                continue
1358            if resource_id in excluded_ids:
1359                exclude(profile, "ALREADY_ATTEMPTED", "failover_policy")
1360                continue
1361            trust_block = self._workspace_trust_block(resource_id, task)
1362            if trust_block:
1363                # Scoped to this task's workspace: the resource stays eligible elsewhere.
1364                exclude(profile, "WORKSPACE_TRUST_REQUIRED", "workspace_trust", trust_block)
1365                continue
1366            economics = EconomicClass(profile.economic_class or EconomicClass.UNKNOWN)
1367            if economics == EconomicClass.METERED_API and not self.policy.allow_paid_api:
1368                exclude(profile, "PAID_API_FORBIDDEN", "economic_policy")
1369                continue
1370            if (
1371                economics == EconomicClass.METERED_API
1372                and self.policy.max_metered_invocations is not None
1373                and state.metered_invocation_count
1374                >= self.policy.max_metered_invocations
1375            ):
1376                exclude(profile, "METERED_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED", "economic_policy")
1377                continue
1378            candidates.append(profile)
1379
1380        recommendation = self._recommend(task, role, candidates)
1381        avoid_id = self._normalize(avoid_resource_id) if avoid_resource_id else None
1382        candidates.sort(key=lambda profile: self._ranking_key(profile, recommendation, avoid_id))
1383        supplied_explicit = explicit_resource_id or task.preferred_agent
1384        explicit_id = self._normalize(supplied_explicit) if supplied_explicit else None
1385        selected: Optional[AgentProfile] = None
1386        if explicit_id:
1387            selected = next(
1388                (profile for profile in candidates if profile.resource_id == explicit_id),
1389                None,
1390            )
1391            if selected is None:
1392                candidates = []
1393        elif candidates:
1394            selected = candidates[0]
1395
1396        status = (
1397            ResourceSelectionStatus.SELECTED
1398            if selected is not None
1399            else ResourceSelectionStatus.BLOCKED
1400        )
1401        identities = [self._resource_identity(profile) for profile in candidates]
1402        selected_identity = self._resource_identity(selected) if selected else None
1403        if selected_identity is not None:
1404            identities = [selected_identity] + [
1405                identity for identity in identities
1406                if identity.resource_id != selected_identity.resource_id
1407            ]
1408        return ResourceSelectionDecision(
1409            task_class=task.task_class,
1410            role=role,
1411            required_capabilities=required,
1412            status=status,
1413            registered_resources=registered,
1414            eligible_resources=identities,
1415            exclusions=exclusions,
1416            selected=selected_identity,
1417            selection_policy=self.policy.strategy,
1418            economic_policy=self.policy.model_dump(),
1419            cognitive_recommendation=recommendation,
1420            capacity_before=self.get_all_statuses(),
1421            explicit_override=explicit_id is not None,
1422            blocked_reason=(
1423                None if selected is not None else "NO_ELIGIBLE_AI_RESOURCE"
1424            ),
1425        )

Applies hard filtering, economics, recommendation, and stable tie break.

avoid_resource_id is a soft preference that only demotes a resource in the ranking. exclude_resource_ids is a hard prohibition, used by bounded failover so a resource whose cooldown elapsed mid-attempt cannot be re-offered and dead-end the loop.

def select_candidates( self, task_category: str = 'code_heavy', avoid_provider: Optional[str] = None, preferred_agent: Optional[str] = None, task: Optional[howlplane.control_plane.task_spec.TaskSpec] = None, role: str = 'implementation') -> List[str]: 
1435    def select_candidates(
1436        self,
1437        task_category: str = "code_heavy",
1438        avoid_provider: Optional[str] = None,
1439        preferred_agent: Optional[str] = None,
1440        task: Optional[TaskSpec] = None,
1441        role: str = "implementation",
1442    ) -> List[str]:
1443        """Compatibility API returning the new pipeline's ordered candidates.
1444
1445        `role` is the role the candidates are actually for. It used to be
1446        hardcoded to "implementation", so reviewer failover picked its fallback
1447        pool using implementation capability requirements rather than the review
1448        role's -- the wrong question for the candidate it was choosing.
1449        """
1450        if task is None or self._legacy_mode:
1451            preference = TASK_SUITABILITY_PREFERENCES.get(
1452                task_category,
1453                TASK_SUITABILITY_PREFERENCES["code_heavy"],
1454            )
1455            result = []
1456            for agent_id in preference:
1457                normalized = self._normalize(agent_id)
1458                if (
1459                    task is not None
1460                    and normalized in LOCAL_PROVIDER_IDS
1461                    and not is_task_local_eligible(task)
1462                ):
1463                    continue
1464                if self.get_status(normalized) in {
1465                    ProviderAvailabilityStatus.AVAILABLE,
1466                    ProviderAvailabilityStatus.UNKNOWN,
1467                    ProviderAvailabilityStatus.DEGRADED,
1468                }:
1469                    result.append(normalized)
1470            if preferred_agent:
1471                preferred = self._normalize(preferred_agent)
1472                if preferred in result:
1473                    result.remove(preferred)
1474                    result.insert(0, preferred)
1475            if avoid_provider:
1476                avoided = self._normalize(avoid_provider)
1477                if avoided in result:
1478                    result.remove(avoided)
1479                    result.append(avoided)
1480            return list(dict.fromkeys(result))
1481        decision = self.select_resource(
1482            task,
1483            role=role,
1484            explicit_resource_id=preferred_agent,
1485            avoid_resource_id=avoid_provider,
1486        )
1487        return [identity.resource_id for identity in decision.eligible_resources]

Compatibility API returning the new pipeline's ordered candidates.

role is the role the candidates are actually for. It used to be hardcoded to "implementation", so reviewer failover picked its fallback pool using implementation capability requirements rather than the review role's -- the wrong question for the candidate it was choosing.

def select_reviewers( self, implementing_agent_id: str, required_roles: List[str], allow_same_provider: bool = False, task: Optional[howlplane.control_plane.task_spec.TaskSpec] = None) -> Tuple[Dict[str, str], bool]: 
1489    def select_reviewers(
1490        self,
1491        implementing_agent_id: str,
1492        required_roles: List[str],
1493        allow_same_provider: bool = False,
1494        task: Optional[TaskSpec] = None,
1495    ) -> Tuple[Dict[str, str], bool]:
1496        """Selects role-capable reviewers and reports identity diversity honestly."""
1497        implementation_id = self._normalize(implementing_agent_id)
1498        if self._legacy_mode:
1499            available = [
1500                profile.resource_id or profile.agent_id
1501                for profile in self.registry.list_resources()
1502                if self.get_status(profile.resource_id or profile.agent_id)
1503                == ProviderAvailabilityStatus.AVAILABLE
1504            ]
1505            distinct = [item for item in available if item != implementation_id]
1506            mapping: Dict[str, str] = {}
1507            diversity = True
1508            for index, role in enumerate(required_roles):
1509                role_candidates = distinct
1510                if role in LOCAL_INELIGIBLE_REVIEWER_ROLES:
1511                    role_candidates = [
1512                        item for item in role_candidates if item not in LOCAL_PROVIDER_IDS
1513                    ]
1514                if role_candidates:
1515                    mapping[role] = role_candidates[index % len(role_candidates)]
1516                else:
1517                    mapping[role] = implementation_id
1518                    diversity = False
1519            return mapping, diversity
1520        implementation = self.registry.get_resource(implementation_id)
1521        review_task = task or TaskSpec(
1522            task_id="REVIEW-SELECTION",
1523            repository="unknown",
1524            objective="Review an implementation diff",
1525            task_class="other",
1526            risk_level="medium",
1527        )
1528        mapping: Dict[str, str] = {}
1529        diversity = True
1530        used: Set[str] = set()
1531        for role in required_roles:
1532            decision = self.select_resource(
1533                review_task,
1534                role=role,
1535                avoid_resource_id=implementation_id,
1536            )
1537            eligible = [
1538                self.registry.get_resource(identity.resource_id)
1539                for identity in decision.eligible_resources
1540            ]
1541            eligible = [profile for profile in eligible if profile is not None]
1542            distinct = [
1543                profile for profile in eligible
1544                if profile.resource_id != implementation_id
1545                and implementation is not None
1546                and profile.provider_id != implementation.provider_id
1547            ]
1548            choices = distinct or [
1549                profile for profile in eligible if profile.resource_id != implementation_id
1550            ]
1551            if choices:
1552                unused = [profile for profile in choices if profile.resource_id not in used]
1553                chosen = (unused or choices)[0]
1554                mapping[role] = chosen.resource_id or chosen.agent_id
1555                used.add(chosen.resource_id or chosen.agent_id)
1556                if chosen not in distinct:
1557                    diversity = False
1558            elif implementation is not None:
1559                mapping[role] = implementation_id
1560                diversity = False
1561            elif allow_same_provider and decision.selected:
1562                mapping[role] = decision.selected.resource_id
1563                diversity = False
1564        return mapping, diversity

Selects role-capable reviewers and reports identity diversity honestly.

129@dataclass
130class TaskSpec(DataClassSerializationMixin):
131    """Represents a discrete engineering task handled by the multi-agent control plane."""
132
133    task_id: str
134    repository: str
135    objective: str
136    acceptance_criteria: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
137    constraints: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
138    task_class: str = "feature"
139    risk_level: str = "medium"
140    required_skills: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
141    recommended_reasoning_tier: str = "tier_2"
142    preferred_agent: Optional[str] = None
143    recommended_agent: Optional[str] = None
144    # Durable audit answer to "who produced the work this task is governing".
145    # Provisional while implementation is still moving between resources, and
146    # pinned to the effective implementer the moment implementation settles.
147    # It is NOT a dispatch slot: nothing may overwrite it to tell a backend
148    # which resource to invoke, which is exactly how a reviewer's provider id
149    # ended up here on HOWLFRAM-BUG-52 (issues.md #16). Use
150    # `dispatch_resource_id` / `dispatch_target` for that.
151    actual_agent: Optional[str] = None
152    # The single authoritative effective-implementer identity (issues.md #16).
153    # Written once implementation settles -- on success, on promotion of a
154    # retained candidate, and on recovery after an interruption -- and never
155    # written by any review, remediation or dispatch path. `actual_agent`
156    # mirrors it so durable task metadata, reviewer-independence records and
157    # the final summary cannot disagree about who produced the candidate.
158    effective_implementer_resource_id: Optional[str] = None
159    # Transient: which resource the *next* backend invocation represents.
160    # Reviewer and implementation failover both rewrite this per attempt; it
161    # carries no audit meaning and is deliberately excluded from every
162    # "who implemented this" question.
163    dispatch_resource_id: Optional[str] = None
164    is_override: Optional[bool] = None
165    override_reason: Optional[str] = None
166    allowed_tools: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
167    prohibited_actions: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
168    verification_requirements: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
169    reviewer_requirements: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
170    human_approval_requirements: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
171    current_state: str = "discovered"
172    task_journal_path: Optional[str] = None
173    # Exact repo-relative paths this task may commit (#59.2 Phase 8). Empty
174    # (the default) means unrestricted -- existing serialized task.yaml files
175    # without this key deserialize unaffected. When non-empty,
176    # GitIntegrationExecutor.stage_and_commit fails closed on any other path.
177    allowed_paths: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
178    metadata: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
179    schema: str = TASK_SPEC_SCHEMA_VERSION
180
181    def __post_init__(self):
182        self.validate()
183
184    @property
185    def dispatch_target(self) -> Optional[str]:
186        """Which resource the next backend invocation represents.
187
188        Falls back to `actual_agent` so a caller that never set a dispatch
189        target (implementation paths that construct a fresh TaskSpec per
190        candidate) keeps its existing behaviour. Being a property rather than
191        a field, it is never serialized.
192        """
193        return self.dispatch_resource_id or self.actual_agent
194
195    def validate(self) -> None:
196        """Validates internal fields against allowed enums and non-empty constraints."""
197        if not self.task_id or not isinstance(self.task_id, str):
198            raise TaskSpecValidationError("task_id must be a non-empty string")
199        if not self.repository or not isinstance(self.repository, str):
200            raise TaskSpecValidationError("repository must be a non-empty string")
201        if not self.objective or not isinstance(self.objective, str):
202            raise TaskSpecValidationError("objective must be a non-empty string")
203        if self.task_class not in VALID_TASK_CLASSES:
204            raise TaskSpecValidationError(
205                f"task_class '{self.task_class}' invalid. Allowed: {sorted(VALID_TASK_CLASSES)}"
206            )
207        if self.risk_level not in VALID_RISK_LEVELS:
208            raise TaskSpecValidationError(
209                f"risk_level '{self.risk_level}' invalid. Allowed: {sorted(VALID_RISK_LEVELS)}"
210            )
211        if self.recommended_reasoning_tier not in VALID_REASONING_TIERS:
212            raise TaskSpecValidationError(
213                f"recommended_reasoning_tier '{self.recommended_reasoning_tier}' invalid."
214            )
215        if self.current_state not in VALID_TASK_STATES:
216            raise TaskSpecValidationError(
217                f"current_state '{self.current_state}' invalid. Allowed: {sorted(VALID_TASK_STATES)}"
218            )
219        if self.schema != TASK_SPEC_SCHEMA_VERSION:
220            raise TaskSpecValidationError(
221                f"schema '{self.schema}' invalid. Expected '{TASK_SPEC_SCHEMA_VERSION}'"
222            )
223
224    def transition_to(self, new_state: str, reason: str = "") -> None:
225        """
226        Transitions the task to a new lifecycle state.
227        Raises InvalidStateTransitionError if the transition is illegal.
228        """
229        if new_state not in VALID_TASK_STATES:
230            raise InvalidStateTransitionError(f"Unknown target state: {new_state}")
231
232        allowed = STATE_TRANSITIONS.get(self.current_state, set())
233        if new_state not in allowed:
234            raise InvalidStateTransitionError(
235                f"Cannot transition task '{self.task_id}' from '{self.current_state}' to '{new_state}'. "
236                f"Allowed transitions from '{self.current_state}': {sorted(allowed)}"
237            )
238
239        self.current_state = new_state
240        if "history" not in self.metadata:
241            self.metadata["history"] = []
242        self.metadata["history"].append(
243            {"to_state": new_state, "reason": reason}
244        )
245
246    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
247        """Converts TaskSpec to dictionary representation."""
248        return asdict(self)
249
250    @classmethod
251    def from_dict(cls, data: Dict[str, Any]) -> "TaskSpec":
252        """Constructs a TaskSpec from a dictionary."""
253        d = dict(data)
254        d.pop("schema", None)
255        valid_fields = {f.name for f in fields(cls)}
256        filtered = {k: v for k, v in d.items() if k in valid_fields}
257        return cls(schema=TASK_SPEC_SCHEMA_VERSION, **filtered)
258
259    def to_json(self, indent: int = 2) -> str:
260        """Serializes TaskSpec to formatted JSON string."""
261        return json.dumps(self.to_dict(), indent=indent)
262
263    @classmethod
264    def from_json(cls, json_str: str) -> "TaskSpec":
265        """Deserializes TaskSpec from JSON string."""
266        data = json.loads(json_str)
267        return cls.from_dict(data)

def find_git_repo_root(start_dir: Union[str, pathlib.Path, NoneType] = None) -> pathlib.Path: 
77def find_git_repo_root(start_dir: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None) -> Path:
78    """Discovers the root directory of the current Git repository using `git rev-parse`."""
79    target = Path(start_dir or os.getcwd()).resolve()
80    try:
81        res = run_git_in_repo(target, ["rev-parse", "--show-toplevel"])
82        if res.returncode == 0 and res.stdout.strip():
83            return Path(res.stdout.strip()).resolve()
84    except Exception:
85        pass
86
87    curr = target
88    while curr != curr.parent:
89        if (curr / ".git").exists():
90            return curr
91        curr = curr.parent
92
93    raise TargetRepositoryNotFoundError(
94        f"ERROR: no target Git repository found in '{target}'. HowlPlane must be run inside a Git repository."
95    )

Discovers the root directory of the current Git repository using git rev-parse.

def find_control_plane_root(override_path: Optional[str] = None) -> pathlib.Path: 
 98def find_control_plane_root(override_path: Optional[str] = None) -> Path:
 99    """Discovers the HowlPlane repository path using the 5-step precedence."""
100    if override_path:
101        p = Path(override_path).expanduser().resolve()
102        if (p / "src" / "howlplane" / "control_plane").is_dir() or (p / "src" / "control_plane").is_dir() or (p / "AGENTS.md").is_file():
103            return p
104        raise ControlPlaneNotFoundError(
105            f"ERROR: specified HowlPlane control plane path does not exist: {override_path}"
106        )
107
108    # 1. Primary canonical environment variable: HOWLPLANE_HOME / HOWLPLANE_DIR
109    env_path = os.environ.get("HOWLPLANE_HOME") or os.environ.get("HOWLPLANE_DIR")
110    if env_path:
111        p = Path(env_path).expanduser().resolve()
112        if (p / "src" / "howlplane" / "control_plane").is_dir() or (p / "src" / "control_plane").is_dir() or (p / "AGENTS.md").is_file():
113            return p
114        raise ControlPlaneNotFoundError(
115            f"ERROR: HOWLPLANE_HOME environment variable points to invalid path: {env_path}"
116        )
117
118    # 2. Deprecated legacy environment variable: AI_KNOWLEDGE_LIBRARY
119    legacy_env = os.environ.get("AI_KNOWLEDGE_LIBRARY")
120    if legacy_env:
121        p = Path(legacy_env).expanduser().resolve()
122        if (p / "src" / "howlplane" / "control_plane").is_dir() or (p / "src" / "control_plane").is_dir() or (p / "AGENTS.md").is_file():
123            print(
124                "WARNING: AI_KNOWLEDGE_LIBRARY environment variable is deprecated; please use HOWLPLANE_HOME instead.",
125                file=sys.stderr,
126            )
127            return p
128        raise ControlPlaneNotFoundError(
129            f"ERROR: legacy AI_KNOWLEDGE_LIBRARY environment variable points to invalid path: {legacy_env}"
130        )
131
132    # 3. Config file candidates (canonical ~/.config/howlplane/ followed by legacy fallbacks)
133    candidates = [
134        Path.home() / ".config" / "howlplane" / "config.toml",
135        Path.home() / ".config" / "ai-control-plane" / "config.toml",
136        Path.home() / ".config" / "ai" / "config.toml",
137    ]
138    for cfg in candidates:
139        if cfg.is_file():
140            try:
141                txt = cfg.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
142                match = re.search(r'path\s*=\s*["\']([^"\']+)["\']', txt)
143                if match:
144                    p = Path(match.group(1)).expanduser().resolve()
145                    if (p / "src" / "howlplane" / "control_plane").is_dir() or (p / "src" / "control_plane").is_dir() or (p / "AGENTS.md").is_file():
146                        return p
147                    raise ControlPlaneNotFoundError(f"ERROR: configured path in '{cfg}' is invalid: {match.group(1)}")
148            except ControlPlaneNotFoundError:
149                raise
150            except Exception:
151                pass
152
153    # 4. Self repository root detection
154    self_root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
155    if ((self_root / "src" / "howlplane" / "control_plane").is_dir() or (self_root / "src" / "control_plane").is_dir()) and (self_root / "AGENTS.md").is_file():
156        return self_root
157
158    raise ControlPlaneNotFoundError(
159        "ERROR: configured HowlPlane control plane not found.\n"
160        "Please set the HOWLPLANE_HOME environment variable or configure ~/.config/howlplane/config.toml:\n\n"
161        "  [control_plane]\n"
162        "  path = \"/path/to/howlplane\"\n"
163    )

Discovers the HowlPlane repository path using the 5-step precedence.

def infer_task_metadata( objective: str, repo_name: str, explicit_id: Optional[str] = None, explicit_risk: Optional[str] = None, explicit_tier: Optional[str] = None, explicit_class: Optional[str] = None) -> Tuple[str, str, str, str]: 
184def infer_task_metadata(
185    objective: str,
186    repo_name: str,
187    explicit_id: Optional[str] = None,
188    explicit_risk: Optional[str] = None,
189    explicit_tier: Optional[str] = None,
190    explicit_class: Optional[str] = None,
191) -> Tuple[str, str, str, str]:
192    """Infers task ID, task class, risk level, and reasoning tier from objective text."""
193    clean_obj = objective.strip()
194    lowered = clean_obj.lower()
195
196    if explicit_id:
197        task_id = explicit_id
198    else:
199        issue_match = re.search(r'(?:issue|bug|item|task)\s*#?\s*([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)', clean_obj, re.IGNORECASE)
200        if issue_match:
201            issue_val = issue_match.group(1).upper()
202            if issue_val.startswith("TASK-") or issue_val.startswith("IMP-") or issue_val.startswith("ISSUE-"):
203                task_id = issue_val
204            else:
205                pfx = re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9]', '', repo_name).upper()[:8] or "TASK"
206                task_id = f"{pfx}-{issue_val}"
207        else:
208            h_suf = hashlib.sha256(f"{repo_name}:{clean_obj}".encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:6].upper()
209            pfx = re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9]', '', repo_name).upper()[:8] or "TASK"
210            task_id = f"{pfx}-{h_suf}"
211
212    if explicit_class:
213        task_class = explicit_class
214    elif any(k in lowered for k in ["security", "vuln", "auth", "cve", "patch", "exploit"]):
215        task_class = "security_patch"
216    elif any(k in lowered for k in ["fix", "bug", "crash", "error", "defect", "broken", "fail"]):
217        task_class = "bug_fix"
218    elif any(k in lowered for k in ["refactor", "clean", "simplify", "restructure"]):
219        task_class = "refactor"
220    elif any(k in lowered for k in ["test", "falsif", "mock", "assert", "coverage"]):
221        task_class = "test"
222    elif any(k in lowered for k in ["doc", "readme", "comment", "guide"]):
223        task_class = "documentation"
224    elif any(k in lowered for k in ["deploy", "infra", "terraform", "helm", "k8s", "docker"]):
225        task_class = "infrastructure"
226    else:
227        task_class = "feature"
228
229    if explicit_risk:
230        risk_level = explicit_risk
231    elif any(k in lowered for k in ["critical", "production", "deploy", "terraform apply", "drop table", "credential", "secret"]):
232        risk_level = "critical"
233    elif any(k in lowered for k in ["security", "vuln", "auth", "boundary", "migration", "k8s", "ingress", "infra"]):
234        risk_level = "high"
235    elif any(k in lowered for k in ["doc", "typo", "readme", "comment", "format", "style", "lint"]):
236        risk_level = "low"
237    else:
238        risk_level = "medium"
239
240    if explicit_tier:
241        reasoning_tier = explicit_tier
242    elif risk_level in ("high", "critical") or task_class in ("security_patch", "infrastructure"):
243        reasoning_tier = "tier_1"
244    elif risk_level == "low" and task_class == "documentation":
245        reasoning_tier = "tier_3"
246    else:
247        reasoning_tier = "tier_2"
248
249    return task_id, task_class, risk_level, reasoning_tier

Infers task ID, task class, risk level, and reasoning tier from objective text.

def format_agent_launch_command( agent_id: str, spec: howlplane.control_plane.task_spec.TaskSpec, run_dir: pathlib.Path, target_repo: pathlib.Path) -> str: 
252def format_agent_launch_command(agent_id: str, spec: TaskSpec, run_dir: Path, target_repo: Path) -> str:
253    """Generates the exact recommended agent launch command for the selected agent."""
254    t_path = run_dir / "task.yaml"
255    rel_p = str(t_path.relative_to(target_repo)) if t_path.is_relative_to(target_repo) else str(t_path)
256
257    if agent_id == "agy":
258        return f'agy -p "Task: {spec.task_id} - {spec.objective}. Review task spec at {rel_p} and execute." --mode accept-edits'
259    elif agent_id == "claude_code":
260        return f'claude "Execute governed task {spec.task_id}: {spec.objective} using control plane spec at {rel_p}"'
261    elif agent_id == "codex":
262        return f'codex "Execute task {spec.task_id}: {spec.objective} per {rel_p}"'
263    elif agent_id == "devin_cli":
264        return f'devin run --task-file {rel_p}'
265    elif agent_id == "local_ollama":
266        return f'ollama run qwen2.5-coder:32b "Task {spec.task_id}: {spec.objective}"'
267    return f'# Launch {agent_id} for task spec at {rel_p}'

Generates the exact recommended agent launch command for the selected agent.

def create_task_plan( ctx: howlplane.control_plane.project_adapter.ProjectContext, target_repo: pathlib.Path, cp_root: Optional[pathlib.Path], args: argparse.Namespace, resource_pool: Optional[howlplane.control_plane.synthesis.provider_pool.ProviderPoolManager] = None) -> Tuple[howlplane.control_plane.task_spec.TaskSpec, howlplane.control_plane.router.RoutingDecision]: 
270def create_task_plan(
271    ctx: ProjectContext,
272    target_repo: Path,
273    cp_root: Optional[Path],
274    args: argparse.Namespace,
275    resource_pool: Optional[ProviderPoolManager] = None,
276) -> Tuple[TaskSpec, RoutingDecision]:
277    """Helper that constructs and routes a TaskSpec from CLI arguments."""
278    tid, tclass, risk, tier = infer_task_metadata(
279        objective=args.objective,
280        repo_name=ctx.name,
281        explicit_id=getattr(args, "task_id", None),
282        explicit_risk=getattr(args, "risk", None),
283        explicit_tier=getattr(args, "tier", None),
284        explicit_class=getattr(args, "task_class", None),
285    )
286    skills = list(dict.fromkeys(ctx.skills + (getattr(args, "skills", None) or ["software_development"])))
287    meta = {"target_repo_path": str(target_repo)}
288    if cp_root:
289        meta["control_plane_path"] = str(cp_root)
290
291    spec = TaskSpec(
292        task_id=tid,
293        repository=ctx.name,
294        objective=args.objective,
295        acceptance_criteria=getattr(args, "criteria", None) or [f"Complete objective: {args.objective}", "Pass deterministic verification suite"],
296        constraints=getattr(args, "constraints", None) or ["Adhere to project AGENTS.md and control plane policies"],
297        task_class=tclass,
298        risk_level=risk,
299        required_skills=skills,
300        recommended_reasoning_tier=tier,
301        preferred_agent=getattr(args, "agent", None),
302        metadata=meta,
303    )
304    decision = TaskRouter(resource_pool=resource_pool).route(spec)
305    return spec, decision

Helper that constructs and routes a TaskSpec from CLI arguments.

def cmd_work(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int: 
489def cmd_work(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
490    """Executes the governed work command from any target repository."""
491    target_repo = _resolve_repo(args)
492    cp_root = find_control_plane_root(getattr(args, "control_plane_dir", None))
493
494    if not getattr(args, "skip_doctor", False):
495        from howlplane.control_plane.doctor import check_dependencies, check_git_status
496        dep_res = check_dependencies()
497        if dep_res.status == "error" and not getattr(args, "force", False):
498            print(f"ERROR: control-plane preflight failed: {dep_res.message}", file=sys.stderr)
499            return 1
500        git_res = check_git_status(target_repo)
501        if git_res.status == "error" and not getattr(args, "force", False):
502            print(f"ERROR: target repository preflight failed: {git_res.message}", file=sys.stderr)
503            return 1
504
505    ctx = ProjectAdapter.discover(target_repo)
506    resource_pool = ProviderPoolManager.from_config()
507    spec, decision = create_task_plan(
508        ctx, target_repo, cp_root, args, resource_pool=resource_pool
509    )
510
511    planned_actions = getattr(args, "actions", None) or []
512    progress_mode = getattr(args, "progress", "auto")
513    if getattr(args, "quiet", False):
514        progress_mode = "never"
515
516    orchestrator = GovernedTaskOrchestrator(
517        target_repo=target_repo,
518        control_plane_root=cp_root,
519        config=OrchestrationConfig(
520            force=getattr(args, "force", False),
521            skip_doctor=getattr(args, "skip_doctor", False),
522            provider_pool=resource_pool,
523            progress_mode=progress_mode,
524        ),
525    )
526
527    if getattr(args, "execute", False):
528        res = orchestrator.run(spec, planned_actions=planned_actions)
529        _print_orchestration_summary(res, ctx, spec, decision)
530        return res.exit_code
531
532    # Dry run / task preparation mode (default when --execute is omitted)
533    ctx, decision, plan, run_dir, shadow_audit_res = orchestrator.prepare_task_plan(spec, planned_actions)
534    boundary_res = HumanBoundaryGate.evaluate(spec, planned_actions=planned_actions, verification=plan)
535    if not decision.selected_agent_id and not boundary_res.requires_human_approval:
536        print(json.dumps(decision.metadata["blocked_outcome"], indent=2))
537        return 3
538    launch_cmd = format_agent_launch_command(decision.selected_agent_id, spec, run_dir, target_repo)
539    df_mode = get_dogfood_mode()
540
541    print("=" * 60)
542    print("AI ENGINEERING CONTROL PLANE — TASK INITIALIZED")
543    print("=" * 60)
544    print(f"Target Repository:    {target_repo} ({ctx.name})")
545    print(f"Project Stack:        {', '.join(ctx.project_types) or 'generic'}")
546    print(f"Project AGENTS.md:    {'Present' if ctx.has_agents_md else 'Not found (using global policy)'}")
547    print(f"Hygiene Policy:       {ctx.hygiene_status}")
548    print(f"Task ID:              {spec.task_id}")
549    print(f"Objective:            {spec.objective}")
550    print(f"Risk Level:           {spec.risk_level.upper()}")
551    print(f"Reasoning Tier:       {decision.reasoning_tier}")
552    if decision.is_override:
553        print(f"Override Note:        {decision.override_reason}")
554    if df_mode == "shadow" and shadow_audit_res:
555        print("-" * 60)
556        print("HOWLFRAME SHADOW AUDIT (DOGFOODING):")
557        print(f"  Result:             {shadow_audit_res.audit_status or 'N/A'} ({shadow_audit_res.status}) [{shadow_audit_res.duration_seconds}s]")
558        if shadow_audit_res.findings:
559            print(f"  Findings:           {', '.join(shadow_audit_res.findings)}")
560        if shadow_audit_res.comparison_notes:
561            print(f"  Disagreements:      {', '.join(shadow_audit_res.comparison_notes)}")
562    print("-" * 60)
563    print("TASK ROUTING DECISION:")
564    print(f"Selected Agent:       {decision.selected_agent_name} (`{decision.selected_agent_id}`)")
565    print(f"Rationale:            {decision.rationale}")
566    print(f"Reviewer Roles:       {', '.join(decision.recommended_reviewers)}")
567    print("-" * 60)
568    print("DETERMINISTIC VERIFICATION PLAN:")
569    if plan.steps:
570        for idx, s in enumerate(plan.steps, 1):
571            print(f"  {idx}. [{s.category}] {s.name}")
572    else:
573        print("  (No automatic test/build steps discovered)")
574    print("-" * 60)
575    print("HUMAN AUTHORITY BOUNDARY:")
576    if boundary_res.requires_human_approval:
577        print("  🛑 AWAITING HUMAN APPROVAL (Boundary Triggered)")
578        for b in boundary_res.triggered_boundaries:
579            print(f"     - Boundary: {b}")
580        if boundary_res.decision_packet:
581            dp_path = run_dir / "decision_packet.md"
582            dp_path.write_text(boundary_res.decision_packet.render_markdown(), encoding="utf-8")
583            print(f"     - Decision packet written to: {dp_path}")
584    else:
585        print("  ✓ All actions within Autonomous Operating Authority")
586    print("-" * 60)
587    print("RUN ARTIFACTS PREPARED:")
588    print(f"Run Directory:        {run_dir}")
589    print(f"- Task Spec:          {run_dir / 'task.yaml'}")
590    print(f"- Review Briefs:      {run_dir / 'reviews'}/ ({len(decision.recommended_reviewers)} briefs)")
591    print(f"- Findings Template:  {run_dir / 'findings_template.yaml'}")
592    print(f"- Verification Plan:  {run_dir / 'verification_plan.json'}")
593    print("-" * 60)
594    print("RECOMMENDED AGENT LAUNCH COMMAND:")
595    print(f"  {launch_cmd}")
596    print("=" * 60)
597
598    return 2 if boundary_res.requires_human_approval else 0

Executes the governed work command from any target repository.

def cmd_route(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int: 
601def cmd_route(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
602    """Lightweight read-only routing of an objective against the current target repository."""

624    """Shows inventory or resets exactly one current capacity record."""

639            task_id="AI-RESOURCE-POOL",

641            action="provider_capacity_reset",
642            result="reset",

645                "capacity": state.status.value,
646                "readiness": state.readiness.value,
647            },
648        ))

650            f"Reset {resource_id}: readiness={state.readiness.value}; "

656        json.dumps(inventory_document(pool), indent=2)
657        if getattr(args, "json", False) else render_inventory(pool)
658    )
659    return 0

def cmd_status(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int: 
662def cmd_status(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
663    """Displays project status, active task runs, lock status, and crash recovery diagnostics."""
664    target_repo = _resolve_repo(args)
665    cp_root = find_control_plane_root(getattr(args, "control_plane_dir", None))
666    ctx = ProjectAdapter.discover(target_repo)
667
668    print("=" * 60)
669    print(f"AI CONTROL PLANE — PROJECT STATUS: {ctx.name}")
670    print("=" * 60)
671    print(f"Repository Path:    {target_repo}")
672    print(f"Control Plane:      {cp_root}")
673    print(f"Project Stack:      {', '.join(ctx.project_types) or 'generic'}")
674    print(f"Project AGENTS.md:  {'Present' if ctx.has_agents_md else 'Not found'}")
675    print(f"Hygiene Status:     {ctx.hygiene_status}")
676
677    # Inspect Repository Lock
678    repo_lock_file = get_repo_lock_path(target_repo)
679    if repo_lock_file.exists():
680        try:
681            l_data = json.loads(repo_lock_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
682            alive, _ = is_process_alive(l_data.get("pid", 0), l_data.get("hostname", ""))
683            status_str = "ACTIVE" if alive else "STALE (Reclaimable)"
684            print(f"Repository Lock:    {status_str} — Task: {l_data.get('task_id')}, PID: {l_data.get('pid')}, Command: '{l_data.get('command')}'")
685        except Exception:
686            print("Repository Lock:    Present (Unparseable)")
687    else:
688        print("Repository Lock:    Unlocked (Available)")
689
690    print("-" * 60)
691    print("VERIFICATION COMMANDS DISCOVERED:")
692    plan = ProjectAdapter.create_verification_plan(ctx, task_id="STATUS-CHECK")
693    if plan.steps:
694        for idx, s in enumerate(plan.steps, 1):
695            cmd_display = ' '.join(s.command) if isinstance(s.command, list) else s.command
696            print(f"  {idx}. [{s.category}] {cmd_display}")
697    else:
698        print("  (No automatic test/build commands detected)")
699
700    df_mode = get_dogfood_mode()
701    h_bin = find_howlframe_binary()
702    h_ver = get_howlframe_version(h_bin) if h_bin else None
703    print("-" * 60)
704    print("HOWLFRAME DOGFOOD STATUS:")
705    print(f"  Mode:               {df_mode}")
706    if h_bin:
707        print(f"  Binary:             {h_bin} ({h_ver or '0.1.0'})")
708        if df_mode == "shadow":
709            audit_res = HowlFrameAuditRunner.run_audit(ctx, record_evidence=False, dogfood_mode="shadow")
710            print(f"  Audit Result:       {audit_res.audit_status or 'N/A'} ({audit_res.status}) [{audit_res.duration_seconds}s]")
711            if audit_res.findings:
712                print(f"  Findings:           {', '.join(audit_res.findings)}")
713            if audit_res.comparison_notes:
714                print(f"  Disagreements:      {', '.join(audit_res.comparison_notes)}")
715    else:
716        print("  Binary:             Not available (PATH)")
717
718    task_runs_dir = target_repo / ".task_runs"
719    runs = []
720    if task_runs_dir.is_dir():
721        runs = [d.name for d in task_runs_dir.iterdir() if d.is_dir() and (d / "task.yaml").exists()]
722
723    print("-" * 60)
724    print(f"ACTIVE TASK RUNS ({len(runs)}):")
725    if runs:
726        for r in sorted(runs):
727            t_dir = task_runs_dir / r
728            t_file = t_dir / "task.yaml"
729            try:
730                rec_diag = CrashRecoveryEngine.inspect_task(target_repo, r)
731                t_spec = TaskSpec.load_from_file(str(t_file))
732                rec_file = t_dir / "reconciliation.json"
733                blockers = 0
734                highs = 0
735                if rec_file.exists():
736                    try:
737                        rec_data = json.loads(rec_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
738                        blockers = rec_data.get("summary", {}).get("unresolved_blockers", 0)
739                        highs = rec_data.get("summary", {}).get("unresolved_highs", 0)
740                    except Exception:
741                        pass
742                ver_file = t_dir / "verification_result.json"
743                ver_status = "unverified"
744                if ver_file.exists():
745                    try:
746                        ver_data = json.loads(ver_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
747                        ver_status = ver_data.get("overall_status", "unverified")
748                    except Exception:
749                        pass
750
751                dp_file = t_dir / "decision_packet.md"

753                    str(dp_file.relative_to(target_repo))
754                    if dp_file.is_file() and dp_file.is_relative_to(target_repo)
755                    else str(dp_file)
756                )
757
758                prog_file = t_dir / "progress.json"
759                prog_data = None
760                if prog_file.is_file():
761                    try:
762                        prog_data = safe_load_json(prog_file)
763                    except Exception:
764                        prog_data = None
765
766                if t_spec.current_state == "awaiting_human":
767                    dec_record = HumanLifecycleManager.load_decision(t_dir)
768                    current_fp = compute_repository_fingerprint(target_repo, t_dir)
769                    boundaries_list = t_spec.human_approval_requirements or ["human_authority_boundary"]
770                    boundaries_str = ", ".join(boundaries_list)
771                    receipt_file = t_dir / "execution_receipt.json"
772
773                    print(f"  Task:               {t_spec.task_id}")
774                    print(f"  State:              AWAITING_HUMAN (Stage: {rec_diag.get('last_stage', 'awaiting_human')})")
775                    print(f"  Verification:       {ver_status.upper()}")
776                    if dec_record and dec_record.changeops_decision_id:
777                        print(f"  ChangeOps Decision: {dec_record.changeops_decision_id}")
778                    if receipt_file.is_file():
779                        try:
780                            rc_data = json.loads(receipt_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
781                            print(f"  Execution Receipt:  {rc_data.get('status', 'unknown').upper()} (Verification: {rc_data.get('verification_status', 'PASS')})")
782                        except Exception:
783                            pass
784                    elif rec_diag.get("native_receipt_found"):
785                        print("  Execution Receipt:  PENDING_RECONCILIATION (Found in HowlChangeOps native receipts)")
786
787                    if not dec_record:
788                        print(f"  Repository State:   CURRENT")
789                        print(f"  Boundary:           {boundaries_str}")
790                        print(f"  Decision:           pending")
791                        if dp_file.is_file():
792                            print(f"  Decision Packet:    {dp_rel}")
793                        print("")
794                        print("  Next Action:")
795                        print(f"    howlplane approve {t_spec.task_id}")
796                        print(f"    howlplane reject {t_spec.task_id}")
797                    elif dec_record.decision == "approved":
798                        has_drift, drift_reason = (
799                            check_repository_drift(dec_record.repository_state, current_fp)
800                            if dec_record.repository_state
801                            else (False, None)
802                        )
803                        appr_state = f"STALE ({drift_reason})" if has_drift else "CURRENT"
804                        print(f"  Boundary:           {boundaries_str}")
805                        print(f"  Decision:           APPROVED")
806                        print(f"  Approval State:     {appr_state}")
807                        if dp_file.is_file():
808                            print(f"  Decision Packet:    {dp_rel}")
809                        print("")
810                        print("  Next Action:")
811                        if has_drift:
812                            print(f"    howlplane approve {t_spec.task_id} --reason \"re-approved after drift\"")
813                        else:
814                            print(f"    howlplane resume {t_spec.task_id}")
815                    elif dec_record.decision == "rejected":
816                        print(f"  Decision:           REJECTED")
817                        if dec_record.reason:
818                            print(f"  Reason:             {dec_record.reason}")
819                        print("  Terminal state:     FAILED (Rejected)")
820                    print("-" * 40)
821                elif (
822                    prog_data
823                    and prog_data.get("state") == "RUNNING"
824                    and t_spec.current_state not in TERMINAL_TASK_STATES
825                ):
826                    p_phase = prog_data.get("phase", t_spec.current_state.upper())
827                    p_resource = prog_data.get("resource_id") or t_spec.actual_agent or t_spec.recommended_agent or "N/A"
828                    p_elapsed = format_elapsed(prog_data.get("elapsed_seconds", 0))
829                    p_heartbeat = format_last_heartbeat(prog_data.get("updated_at"))
830                    p_pid = prog_data.get("pid")
831
832                    is_proc_alive = False
833                    if rec_diag.get("is_process_running"):
834                        is_proc_alive = True
835                    elif p_pid:
836                        import socket
837                        from howlplane.control_plane.locking import is_process_alive as check_pid_alive
838                        is_proc_alive, _ = check_pid_alive(p_pid, socket.gethostname())
839
840                    state_label = "RUNNING" if is_proc_alive else "STALE (Process not running)"
841
842                    print(f"  {t_spec.task_id}")
843                    print(f"    State:          {state_label}")
844                    print(f"    Phase:          {p_phase}")
845                    print(f"    Resource:       {p_resource}")
846                    print(f"    Elapsed:        {p_elapsed}")
847                    print(f"    Last heartbeat: {p_heartbeat}")
848                    c_revs = rec_diag.get("completed_reviewers", [])
849                    if c_revs:
850                        print(f"    Completed Reviews: {', '.join(c_revs)}")
851                    for role, disposition in (rec_diag.get("reviewer_dispositions") or {}).items():
852                        if disposition not in ("completed_clean", "completed_with_findings"):
853                            print(f"      - {role}: {disposition.upper()}")
854                    if not is_proc_alive:
855                        rec_action = rec_diag.get('recommendation') or f"howlplane resume {t_spec.task_id}"
856                        print(f"    Recommendation:    {rec_action}")
857                    print("-" * 40)
858                elif t_spec.current_state in ("interrupted", "cancelled", "implementing", "reviewing", "remediating", "verifying"):
859                    print(f"  Task:               {t_spec.task_id}")
860                    print(f"  State:              {t_spec.current_state.upper()} (Last Stage: {rec_diag.get('last_stage')})")
861                    print(f"  Classification:     {rec_diag.get('classification', 'RECONCILE_FIRST')}")
862                    if rec_diag.get("is_process_running"):
863                        p_info = rec_diag.get("process_info") or {}
864                        print(f"  Process:            RUNNING (PID: {p_info.get('pid')}, Backend: {p_info.get('backend')})")
865                    if rec_diag.get("completed_reviewers"):
866                        print(f"  Completed Reviews:  {', '.join(rec_diag.get('completed_reviewers'))}")
867                    if rec_diag.get("incomplete_reviewers"):
868                        print(f"  Pending Reviews:    {', '.join(rec_diag.get('incomplete_reviewers'))}")
869                    for role, disposition in (rec_diag.get("reviewer_dispositions") or {}).items():
870                        if disposition not in ("completed_clean", "completed_with_findings"):
871                            print(f"    - {role}: {disposition.upper()}")
872                    print(f"  Recommendation:     {rec_diag.get('recommendation')}")
873                    print("-" * 40)
874                else:
875                    print(f"  - {r}: [{t_spec.current_state.upper()}] {t_spec.objective} (Risk: {t_spec.risk_level.upper()}, Agent: {t_spec.actual_agent or t_spec.recommended_agent or 'N/A'}, Blockers: {blockers}, Highs: {highs}, Verification: {ver_status})")
876            except Exception:
877                print(f"  - {r}")
878    else:
879        print("  (No task runs in .task_runs/)")
880
881    journal_dir = target_repo / "documentation" / "task_journals"
882    journals = []
883    if journal_dir.is_dir():

888        print(f"TASK JOURNALS ({len(journals)}):")

891
892    print("=" * 60)
893    return 0

 950def cmd_prepare_run(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
 951    """Prepares structured task run directory and reviewer briefs for cross-agent handoffs."""
 952    spec = TaskSpec.load_from_file(args.task_file)
 953    diff_text = Path(args.diff_file).read_text(encoding="utf-8") if args.diff_file else ""
 954
 955    run_dir = Path(args.run_dir or f".task_runs/{spec.task_id}")
 956    reviews_dir = run_dir / "reviews"
 957    reviews_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 958
 959    # Save copy of task spec and diff
 960    spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
 961    if diff_text:
 962        (run_dir / "diff.patch").write_text(diff_text, encoding="utf-8")
 963
 964    router = TaskRouter()
 965    decision = router.route(spec)
 966    reviewers_to_run = args.roles or decision.recommended_reviewers
 967
 968    print(f"Preparing dogfood task run in {run_dir}/...")
 969    print(f"- Implementation Agent: {decision.selected_agent_name} (`{decision.selected_agent_id}`)")
 970    print(f"- Generating {len(reviewers_to_run)} independent reviewer briefs in {reviews_dir}/:")
 971
 972    for role_id in reviewers_to_run:
 973        role = get_reviewer_role(role_id)
 974        if not role:
 975            continue
 976        brief = role.render_brief(task=spec, diff_content=diff_text)
 977        brief_file = reviews_dir / f"{role_id}.md"
 978        brief_file.write_text(brief, encoding="utf-8")
 979        print(f"   ✓ {brief_file.name}")
 980
 981    # Write findings template
 982    template_file = run_dir / "findings_template.yaml"
 983    template_content = """# Review Findings Template
 984# Collect structured findings from independent reviewer roles below.
 985findings:
 986  # Example:
 987  # - id: "F001"
 988  #   reviewer_role: "test-falsifier"
 989  #   title: "Missing negative test case for edge input"
 990  #   severity: "high"
 991  #   category: "test_gap"
 992  #   location: "tests/test_feature.py:45"
 993  #   description: "Test does not check None input handling."
 994  #   evidence: "Calling feature(None) raises unhandled exception."
 995  #   suggested_fix: "Add test_feature_handles_none_gracefully."
 996"""
 997    template_file.write_text(template_content, encoding="utf-8")
 998    print(f"- Template written: {template_file}")
 999    print(f"\nTask run initialized successfully at {run_dir}.")
1000    return 0

1028def cmd_verify(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
1029    """Executes a verification plan for a project or task."""
1030    target_repo = _resolve_repo(args)
1031    context = ProjectAdapter.discover(target_repo)
1032    task_id = getattr(args, "task_id", None) or "VERIFY-RUN"
1033

1037
1038    for step in plan.steps:

1040        interp_info = f" [using {step.interpreter}]" if step.interpreter else ""
1041        print(f"[{mark}] {step.name}: {step.status} (exit {step.exit_code}, {step.duration_seconds}s){interp_info}")
1042        if step.status == "failed" and step.stderr:
1043            print(f"    Error: {step.stderr.strip()[:200]}")
1044
1045    print(f"\nOverall Verification Status: {status.upper()}")
1046
1047    out_file = args.output
1048    if not out_file and args.run_dir:
1049        out_file = str(Path(args.run_dir) / "verification.json")
1050
1051    if out_file:
1052        Path(out_file).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
1053        Path(out_file).write_text(plan.to_json(), encoding="utf-8")
1054        print(f"Saved verification output to {out_file}")
1055
1056    return 0 if status == "passed" else 1
